differs.mechanic: The token runs the whole rail in about two seconds, ticking each node as it leaves, and docks in the button's badge, which presses in once; no cards open and no result slots fill.
differs.layout: A centred CTA stack: heading and sub over one short run of small numbered nodes that ends in a pill button; the parent's left heading and five tall step cards are gone.
differs.data: Each step is reduced to its title and its time, and the payoff is the sum of those times, written under the button when the token lands, instead of per-step results.
differs.moment: The token landing in the button: the badge fills and ticks, the button presses and sends one pulse, rather than the payoff opening in the last card.

blurb: A token runs a short rail of numbered steps and lands in the button at its end, which presses in once while the total time lands underneath.
